# Sigauque Technologies

> Sigauque Technologies builds practical software, web applications, mobile applications, and integrations for people, schools, and businesses in Johannesburg, South Africa.

## Website

- [Home](https://sigauque-technology.co.za/): Company overview, services, software products, and contact details.
- [Privacy policy](https://sigauque-technology.co.za/privacy-policy.html): Privacy information for QuickPOS and OrderSync.

## Products

- HR Solution: Software support for people and human-resources workflows.
- School Connect: Connected technology for school communities.
- QuickPOS: Point-of-sale software for everyday retail.
